description: Say something out loud on other satellites with nobody waking them, e.g. Dinner is ready. Name a room, or leave it out to say it in every room but this one. Set start_conversation to listen there for an answer afterwards with no wake word.

room.description: Where to say it: a room or satellite name, e.g. kitchen. Leave it out for every room but this one.

start_conversation.description: Listen for an answer afterwards, as if the person there had said the wake word.

text.description: What to say, as it should be heard, e.g. Dinner is ready, come down.

name: announce

description: Close the conversation. Call when the task is complete rather than waiting for silence.
name: end_session

description: Forget something you remember about the person you are speaking with, so it is never recalled again. Name it by the id shown beside it in what you remember.

memory_id.description: The id of the memory to forget, e.g. m_3f9c2a10.

name: forget

description: Act on the home through a Home Assistant service: lights, switches, covers, media players, scripts. Target an entity_id from ha_find_entities, or an area_id. Returns the entities whose state changed; an empty list means nothing matched or nothing needed to change. Some calls need the person's yes: they return confirmation_required with a nonce. Ask them, and once they agree, call again with the same arguments and confirmation set to the nonce.

area_id.description: Area to act on, e.g. kitchen. Required unless entity_id is given.

confirmation.description: The nonce from a confirmation_required result, once the person has said yes. Omit it otherwise.

domain.description: Service domain, e.g. light, switch, script.

entity_id.description: Entity to act on, e.g. light.kitchen. Required unless area_id is given.

service.description: Service within the domain, e.g. turn_on, turn_off, toggle.

name: ha_call_service

description: Find Home Assistant entities by domain and name. Call this first when you do not know an entity_id; never guess one.

domain.description: Only entities in this domain, e.g. light.

name.description: Only entities whose name or id contains this text, e.g. kitchen.

name: ha_find_entities

description: Read one entity's current state and attributes from Home Assistant.
name: ha_get_state

description: Search the media library. Takes several seconds to return.

acknowledgement.description: A few words said aloud while this runs, e.g. "Searching the library." They are spoken for you as it starts; do not also call speak for them.

name: media_search

description: Keep a lasting fact about the person you are speaking with, to recall in later conversations. Use it when they ask you to remember something, or tell you a preference that will still hold tomorrow.

fact.description: The fact, as one plain sentence that makes sense on its own later, e.g. Takes oat milk in coffee.

shareable.description: True only when they say the rest of the household may know it.

name: remember

description: Say something to the user. Runs concurrently with other tools; the model chooses when and whether to speak.

mode.description: queue appends after current speech; preempt cancels it; interject ducks and cuts in.

name: speak

description: Cancel a running timer before it ends. Name it by the id timer_start or timer_list gave; call timer_list first when you do not know it.

timer_id.description: The id of the timer to cancel, e.g. t_3f9c2a10.

name: timer_cancel

description: List the household's running timers: each one's id, label, the satellite it was set on, and the seconds left.
name: timer_list

description: Start a countdown timer on this satellite. When it ends, the announcement is said out loud here, whether or not anyone is talking to you then. Returns the timer's id.

announcement.description: What to say when it ends, as one short sentence, e.g. The oven timer is done.

label.description: What it is for, in a word or two, e.g. oven.

seconds.description: How long, in seconds, e.g. 720 for twelve minutes.

name: timer_start
